additions.title: GotJuice — Nvidia: the juice behind the headline
additions.note: Standing segment, 35–40 second format: headline facts and market impact only. Story tipped by Instagram reels (@unseenmarkets, @schemology) and BBC Newshour (Spotify, 9 Nov 2026); verified against NYT, FT, Reuters and TechCrunch reporting and the Nvidia board statement of 8 Nov 2026. Confirmed: board independent investigation opened 8 Nov; Huang staff memo admitting unfaithfulness; House chairs' letter of 5 Nov requesting a closed-door briefing (18 Nov). Alleged, unproven: MSS recruitment of Alice Huang; Megaspeed chip diversion (denied on record by Megaspeed and Nvidia). Corrected from the circulating clips: the stock fell a little over 4% on Monday, not ~10%; Congress requested a briefing, no subpoena issued. Closing line quotes the TeamBlind post title "GG Jensen" (9 Nov 2026).
